title.en: H3 video: unoffered resolution tiers are rejected explicitly
title.zh: H3 视频：未开放分辨率档位改为显式拒绝

summary.en: `minimax-h3-video` keeps the three published tiers `480p` / `736p` / `768p`. The upstream-only `1088p` / `1440p` tiers were wrongly reachable and are now removed from the public enum: sending one returns `400` (`plugin_usage_invalid`) instead of being accepted at another tier's price.
summary.zh: `minimax-h3-video` 只保留已发布的 `480p` / `736p` / `768p` 三档。上游存在但未开放的 `1088p` / `1440p` 此前可被误用，现已从公开枚举移除：传入会返回 `400`（`plugin_usage_invalid`），不再被按其它档位的价格受理。

body.en:
## Change

`minimax-h3-video` supports three billing tiers: `480p`, `736p` and `768p`. The upstream-only `1088p` and `1440p` tiers were wrongly reachable through the public enum; they are removed now, so a request carrying one returns `400` (`plugin_usage_invalid`).

## Impact

- The model bills per second and has no resolution dimension, so `1088p` / `1440p` cannot be priced on their own. Before this change such a request was accepted and precharged at the base rate (measured: 12500 raw_quota), the upstream run ended in `FAILED`, and the quota was refunded in full — the tier had neither a price nor a reliable run.
- Unoffered tiers now fail closed: the request is rejected instead of being silently downgraded to `768p` or billed as `768p`.
- The published `480p` / `736p` / `768p` contract and prices are unchanged.

## Documentation

- [MiniMax H3 video line](/en/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3-video)
body.zh:
## 变更

`minimax-h3-video` 只支持 `480p`、`736p`、`768p` 三个计费档位。上游存在但未开放的 `1088p` / `1440p` 此前可从公开枚举误用，现已移除：传入会返回 `400`（`plugin_usage_invalid`）。

## 影响

- 该模型按秒计费、没有分辨率维度，`1088p` / `1440p` 无法单独定价。改动前这类请求会被受理并按基准价预扣（实测 12500 raw_quota），上游最终 `FAILED`、配额全额退还 —— 即该档位既没有价格，实测也不可靠。
- 未开放档位现在一律显式拒绝（fail-closed）：请求被拒，不会静默降级到 `768p`，也不会按 `768p` 计价。
- 已发布的 `480p` / `736p` / `768p` 契约与价格不变。

## 文档

- [MiniMax H3 视频专线](/zh/api-reference/video-series/models/minimax-h3-video)
